<quote by="Proposed: Ana i Taziel i Riqueza, Senator for Segura, Seconded: Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza, Senator for Madruga">Commission the Wrangler's Market in Arbonne. Seeks disbursement of 14 weirwood or equivalent (64 thrones)
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[spy network]] in Arbonne
* Passed at 54 thrones
* 54 thrones disbursed to Senator for Segura
* More information can be found in the '''[[No_Matter_What#Break_the_chains|No matter what]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Summer 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 14 wains of weirwood
* 42 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Wrangler%27s_Market}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the market will have the following effects: 
* The ''Chief Wrangler'' will be available to appoint by Freeborn tally of the votes of fleet owners
* Imperial Orc [[military unit|military units]] will be able to use the market to [[spy network|spy]] on [[Arbonne]]
